<notes>
All base rollouts (base1, base2, base3) succeeded with the correct answer: 243 days. No repeated failures, no divergences. All 6 candidate harnesses show identical diffs (no change) from the base. inv1's rollout produced 244 days instead of 243 — this is incorrect — but it is a single variance (1 of 9 total runs), the harness itself is unchanged from base, and the error traces to the LLM's calculation (inclusive/exclusive endpoint interpretation), not the extraction mechanism. The harness extraction of the last line works correctly on all other runs. Per mission rule: a defect in 1/9 is noise when the pattern is not repeated in the base set. No trajectory moment shows a harness change would prevent or resolve this; the base harness works correctly in 8/9 runs including all 3 base rolls.

kept -> base harness -> all three base rollouts delivered correct answer (243 days) in 1 step with no repeated failures or divergences; no candidate modified the harness; inv1 incorrect answer is model variance in a single run (1/9), not a harness defect
</notes>
